cards.mood: The piece opens with a spacious, ethereal atmosphere that establishes a sense of mystery and introspection.
cards.vocal: A single male vocalist delivers the performance with a smooth, clear tenor timbre that carries a slightly breathy and emotive quality.
cards.palette: Lush, evolving synth pads serve as the harmonic backbone, present from the very beginning and sustaining through to the end, providing a continuous atmospheric bed.
